meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 它把新用户与 omo 的第一次对话变成一次引导：按顺序带你逛功能、迁移旧配置、翻看旧会话、估算缓存省下的钱、边聊边记下你的偏好，最后提议跑 init-deep。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始用 omo 时触发；它只在首次自动启动一次，之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动重跑。

say.text: 我是从 Claude Code 过来的，帮我把配置迁到 omo。
say.note: 它会先给出迁移方案，等你确认再动手。

say.text: 可以看看我以前那些编码会话吗？
帮我估算一下 omo 缓存能省多少钱。
say.note: 它按 Senpi 会话日志算出估算值。

howto.what_en: It turns a new user's first omo conversation into a guided walkthrough: feature tour, config migration, past-session review, cache-savings estimate, memory notes as you go, and a first-session init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; the user can re-run it with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code; help me migrate my setup.
say_en.note: It shows a migration plan and waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Can you look through my previous coding sessions?
Estimate how much caching would have saved me.
say_en.note: It computes an estimate from Senpi session logs.
